policy: Do not mark production certified until every blocker has evidence from the target branch/deployment environment.

known_local_skip.reason: Skipped unless WEATHER_REDIS_INTEGRATION_URL is set; this is the explicit P-CERT-3 live Redis blocker, not a hidden failure.
known_local_skip.certification_impact: acceptable for local offline guard runs; not acceptable for final production certification evidence

blockers.name: Full branch CI
blockers.certification_rule: 0 failed, no unexpected critical skip, no inventory/guard drift

blockers.name: Connected transitive lock generation
required_evidence: official PyPI is the default index
Alibaba mirror is only an explicit override
Tencent mirror is not a default
generated transitive lock files are committed or attached to the release bundle
blockers.certification_rule: reproducible locks generated from connected PyPI/default index or reviewed internal mirror

blockers.name: Redis live integration
required_evidence: WEATHER_REDIS_INTEGRATION_URL points at a real Redis instance
weather Redis live optional test exits 0
blockers.certification_rule: live Redis passes without downgrading readiness honesty

blockers.name: ONNX/SAM2 model provisioning
required_evidence: SAM2 artifacts exist in deployment environment
blockers.certification_rule: strict readiness passes only with provisioned artifacts; absent artifacts fail closed
